label: Particles
description: The floating-detail layer — small drifting elements that give top-rated prompts their depth.

items.name: dust-motes
items.text: fine dust motes hanging in the air, igniting to bright points where they cross the light and vanishing outside it

items.name: embers
items.text: glowing embers rising on the heat, drifting in slow spirals and winking out one by one as they cool

items.name: petals
items.text: loose petals drifting sideways on the breeze

items.name: snow-flurry
items.text: a light flurry of snowflakes hanging in the air

items.name: frozen-splash
items.text: droplets frozen mid-air in a crisp suspended splash

items.name: mist-wisps
items.text: thin wisps of mist curling slowly through the scene

items.name: pollen-glow
items.text: backlit pollen and seed fluff glowing like slow fireflies

items.name: confetti
items.text: scattered confetti caught mid-fall in vivid colors

items.name: sparks
items.text: hot sparks scattering in bright short-lived arcs

items.name: bokeh-orbs
items.text: soft out-of-focus light orbs floating in the background depth

items.name: fireflies
items.text: living fireflies blinking slow green-gold trails low over the ground

items.name: falling-leaves
items.text: dry autumn leaves tumbling and seesawing down through the frame

items.name: ash-fall
items.text: grey ash falling silent as snow, dusting shoulders and edges

items.name: incense-smoke
items.text: a thin ribbon of incense smoke rising laminar and straight before curling into slow turbulent whorls where the air moves

items.name: soap-bubbles
items.text: drifting soap bubbles, iridescent films swirling across each sphere and every one carrying a tiny warped reflection of the scene
